deduplication: One task is question + setup + expected behavior, not a test method or repeated run. Shared facts with different isolation/failure preconditions are distinct behavioral tasks; category denominators are reported separately. Exact duplicates rejected automatically; semantic/source-family review required before freezing.
sourceReview: 2026-10-15: new synthetic TEST families Lumen/Harbor/Mosaic and legacy-client/storage; DEBUG families Solstice and legacy-worker. Existing Atlas/Borealis experiments are not reused as final core test tasks. No production prompts were tuned against these TEST inputs before freezing.

rubric.taskPass: All expected facts/behaviors satisfied, expected terminal reached, no scope/budget/confirmation violation. Human reviewer must sign semantic judgments; schema or keywords alone are insufficient.
rubric.factCorrectness: Correct supported expected facts / number of expected facts. Record one boolean per listed fact; partial correctness is not full task success.
rubric.citationSupport: Supported cited claims / reviewed cited claims; no citations is null, not 100%.
rubric.retrieval: Recall = matched expected evidence anchors / expected anchors; MRR = reciprocal first relevant rank. Evaluate retrieval observations separately from final citations; no anchors means not applicable.
rubric.latency: totalMs from accepted request to terminal; firstProgressMs and firstTextMs from same origin. Include failure/timeout terminal times, report missing values; nearest-rank percentiles.
rubric.usage: Use provider usage including failed/retried calls. Null means unknown. No monetary estimate without a dated currency/price source and explicit per-task costs.
rubric.modes: ENGINEERING, MODEL_FIXED_RETRIEVAL, LIVE_END_TO_END remain separate. Never aggregate their quality percentages. Failed and NOT_RUN cases remain in the task denominator.
